task.description:
Implement backend requirements for Batch F2c on branch feature/WF02-f2c-batch2-20260529:

1. **PD-09 — Export/Import endpoints**:
   - GET /api/v1/definitions/{id}/export: Returns full definition as self-contained JSON with bpm_export_schema_version field. Include all definition fields, full graph, and export format version.
   - POST /api/v1/definitions/import: Accepts export JSON, creates new definition in DRAFT status with new UUID. Validates graph per PD-02. Returns HTTP 201 on success, HTTP 422 on validation failure, HTTP 409 if name+version already exists.
   - Import MUST validate bpm_export_schema_version and reject unsupported versions with HTTP 422.

2. **PD-10 — Search endpoint**:
   - GET /api/v1/definitions/search?q={query}: Full-text search over name and description.
   - Return ranked results (highest-scoring first).
   - Case-insensitive, partial word matching.
   - Reject empty query with HTTP 422.
   - Support pagination per API-06.
   - Reject query > 512 chars with HTTP 422.
   - Empty results: HTTP 200 with empty array.

After implementation: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate. All must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: New endpoints tested via integration tests
